title: Fresh-seed review (53, 54) of c31's crawlers from noise: cells with their own s layer form from the random field on both seeds, but no cell crawls 3 body lengths (seed 53: polarized cells die by t~3, 3 static layered disks remain; seed 54: one large half-moon crawler that absorbs its neighbours, 1.5 body lengths)
summary: Re-ran the claimed world unchanged (labkit, 80 frames, t=16, 256^2) on seeds 53 and 54. Both start from the random two-phase field (first frame) and give round cells by t~0.6 carrying a ring of the layer species s (seed 53: 19/19 individuals membrane-like, rim/core 4.3, rim/out 8.6; seed 54: 5/11, rim/core 2.5, rim/out 8.8). On seed 53 every cell that polarizes shrinks and vanishes by t~2.8, leaving 3 static unpolarized disks to t=16 (max 0.1 body lengths). On seed 54 the polarized cells merge into one half-moon crawler that grows to R_eq ~77 px (a large fraction of the 256 px box) by absorbing static disks, and labkit's longest moving track covers 1.5 sqrt(area) body lengths. B: the s source is kp*phi*rho (the cell's own bound polarity protein), so the layer is the cell's own.

observations.S: rerun/seed53/sheet.png and rerun/seed54/sheet.png t=0: random two-phase field over the whole box
observations.I: rerun/seed53/sheet.png t=2.8-16: 3 discrete round cells persist unchanged to the end (3 tracks alive start-to-end, FACTS.md)
observations.B: rerun/seed53/radial.png: s rim/core 4.28, rim/out 8.56, 19/19 individuals membrane-like; seed 54 rim/core 2.5, 5/11; source kp*phi*rho is the body's own protein (world.py SRC='rho')

seeds_run.result: S, I, B pass; M fail: polarized cells die by t~2.8, survivors static (max 0.1 body lengths)
S, I, B pass; M fail: one crawler, 1.5 sqrt(area) body lengths (FACTS.md), grows by absorbing other cells

verdicts.limitation: M not reached on either fresh seed: on 53 nothing crawls; on 54 the only crawler is a box-scale body that moves 1.5 body lengths (broadside half-moon, so sqrt(area) is the right unit) and its track is broken at each absorption. I did not run the SRC=none or KIN=1 controls; B rests on the radial screen and the code's source term. The layered cells on seed 53 are the static ones, so the layered individuals and the moving ones are not shown to be the same on both seeds.
